memory_order: stable sort by retained strategy score descending, then frozen base generator order
causal_pass_rule: retained-memory arm reaches a passing candidate within 64 charged candidates, exact winner replay passes, and the same passing candidate has a strictly later first-pass rank under the no-memory control order. The effect is search-efficiency causality, not necessarily control-arm failure.
objective_freeze_rule: Issue body and source may be inspected only after this protocol is committed; evaluator must then be frozen before either arm is executed.
claim_boundary: A3 DEVELOPMENT only. A pass establishes causal reuse of one retained search prior on one fresh external task.
